recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, FantasyPros x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage falls back to the DraftKings average points per game, flagged "no projection", unless the CSV lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection stays blank; with no average it stays blank rather than zero.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

notes: Removed from the showdown as out or not expected to play (D45): Josh Jacobs (GB RB, OUT), Jayden Reed (GB WR, OUT), Chris Brooks (GB RB, Injured Reserve), Trey Sermon (ATL RB, IR), Savion Williams (GB WR, IR), Beaux Collins (ATL WR, IR), Thomas Yassmin (GB TE, IR), Luke Musgrave (GB TE, OUT).
